svg.title: Covariance and Gaussian density are those of this same tree choice; selectors and eligibility remain inside the integral. Average over finite layout boundary choices, assigning zero to disallowed layouts and retaining the original scalar overhead. The local vertex and integral estimates are developed in the packet, non-packet and warning arguments below. Expand warnings by Q j(1 + dj) = P Q j∈D dj and regular exponentials by their absolutely D convergent subset expansion. Marked regular keys are dormant: their original coefficient is zero and their unmarked increment e−0 −1 vanishes. Inserting and deleting these keys in selected lists
